M8: Renewable Energy Technologies and Innovations
Lesson 1: Actionable Steps Toward a Sustainable Energy Future

Lesson 1 outlines practical, forward-looking strategies to accelerate the global shift toward a sustainable energy future, focusing on aligning national policies and market incentives with climate and development goals, scaling private sector innovation and investing in workforce development.
Lesson 2: The Innovation Ecosystem for Sustainable Energy
Lesson 2 explores how to build inclusive, future-ready innovation ecosystems that support sustainable energy transitions in developing countries.
It examines strategies to foster clean energy entrepreneurship, strengthen local R&D capabilities, and promote collaboration between startups, investors, academia, and policymakers
Lesson 3: Closing key messages and call to action
This lesson invites the learner to reflect on your role in accelerating change: whether shaping policies, leading projects, or amplifying voices in communities.
